name: Customer places an order and it persists in the marketplace ledger
description: Verifies a customer can build a basket, place a demo order and see the saved order in the restaurant and operations workspaces after navigation.
steps: Add Double Smash Burger to the basket
Open the basket and enter a delivery address if needed
Open Restaurant and confirm the new order is listed
Open NahaLabs and confirm the order appears in the ledger
expected: The order is created once, the basket clears, and the same saved order is visible in the restaurant and NahaLabs workspaces.

name: Restaurant advances an order through preparation
description: Verifies the restaurant can accept a new order and advance it to ready for driver pickup.
setup: Create a customer order through the customer ordering flow
expected: The order status changes from New order to Ready for pickup and the updated status is visible in the other workspaces.

name: Driver accepts a ready delivery and confirms completion
description: Verifies a driver can take a ready order, mark it picked up and confirm delivery.
setup: Create a customer order and advance it through restaurant preparation until it is ready
steps: Review the order and its driver payout
Accept and pick up the order
expected: The order reaches Delivered and the driver's demo earnings increase by the displayed driver payout.

name: NahaLabs allocation matches the agreed R100 food and R35 delivery example
description: Verifies the operations workspace displays the agreed illustrative R135 split and makes clear that payment processing costs are excluded.
steps: Check the R92 restaurant, R32 driver and R11 NahaLabs allocation
expected: The displayed allocations total R135 and clearly state that Paystack approval is pending and live payments are disabled.

name: Reject an invalid order without a basket or delivery address
description: Verifies the checkout cannot create an order with an empty basket or missing delivery address.
steps: Open the basket with no menu items selected
Add a menu item and clear the delivery address
Try to place the order again
expected: Checkout remains disabled for an empty basket or missing address, and the backend rejects invalid order payloads without creating a record.
